name: coordination-hooks
description: Fleet coordination hooks for coordinator-style multi-session workflows: a knowledge-base-first reminder, a check-your-messages reminder, a role-binding reminder, an opt-in idle-wake waiter, an opt-in git-mutation guard, a heartbeat report-alive hook, a rotation-due watch hook, a rotation-due notice hook (rotation_due_notice.py) that delivers the watch hook's self-notify marker as prompt context for a session that has no steward to notify, the memory-passthrough capture/session-context hooks plus their drain/hydrate/sync CLI utilities, and two spawn-injected worker hooks (a headless tool-allowlist gate and a session-mapping capture) fallback-shipped for a spawned worker's own host adapter.
